metadata.name: Virginia DOAV Project Priority System
metadata.agency: Virginia Department of Aviation (DOAV); Virginia Aviation Board (VAB)
metadata.model_version: Airport Program Manual, Appendix D (Project Priority System Scoring Values)
metadata.source_citation: ACRP Synthesis 123 (2023), Chapter 4 — Commonwealth of Virginia case example, pp. 39-41. Sourced from interview with Rusty Harrington, Manager of Planning and Environmental Section, DOAV, May 6, 2022, and the VA DOAV Airport Program Manual (Section 5.8, Chapter 5.0). Range of points (GA 11-250, Reliever 21-260, Air Carrier 11-270) reproduced from Virginia Range of Points table.

decisions_log.author: APH m49 Sprint 6 reference encoder
decisions_log.decision: Encoded Virginia as additive_100pt model with four buckets (Project Merit 0-55, Situational Considerations 0-100+, Airport Category 0-85, Airport Activity 0-85) summing to a possible max of ~270 points for air carrier airports.
decisions_log.rationale: Virginia's stated point ranges and 'objective criteria' description fit the additive_100pt pattern. The four buckets are reflected as 'bucket' attribute on each criterion for UI grouping. Used since-1987 stability of the model as justification for tier scoring rather than formula.
decisions_log.source: ACRP Synthesis 123 p. 40 — 'The VAB and the DOAV have used the same Project Priority Model since 1987'

criteria.label: Project Merit
criteria.description: Categorical merit score (0-55) covering safety, capacity, preservation, upgrades, planning, land/easement, environmental, and maintenance equipment / fueling system.

criteria.label: Situational Considerations
criteria.description: Project- and circumstance-specific points: Special Project Considerations (phased/mandated/policy), Federal Funding Availability, Economic Development Potential, Commercial Service Retention, and Discretionary (overmatch).

subcategories.label: Aligned with current VAB policy priority
Project Retains or Attracts Commercial Service

criteria.label: Airport Operational Conditions
criteria.description: Recognizes airport sponsor compliance and operational quality.

criteria.label: Airport Activity
criteria.description: Activity-based scoring: based aircraft, operations, enplanements, reliever role.

governance.scoring_authority: Virginia Department of Aviation (DOAV), Planning and Environmental Section
governance.approval_process: DOAV reviews each submitted project against the eligibility checklist in Table 3 of the Airport Program Manual. Projects passing eligibility are scored using Appendix D Project Priority System Scoring Values. VAB allocates constrained discretionary Commonwealth Aviation Fund dollars based on ranking.

disclaimer: Encoding based on ACRP Synthesis 123 (2023) description of Virginia DOAV's Project Priority System. Full Appendix D scoring values are referenced but not reproduced in ACRP; subcategory point values are best-effort encodings using the documented point ranges. The model has remained stable since 1987 with only additive variables added — this encoding does not include all post-1987 add-on variables. Verify against DOAV Airport Program Manual Appendix D before adoption.
